slides.title: Florham Park Bagels
slides.body: The early stop. The Taylor ham, egg and cheese is the most-liked item on its Uber Eats page, and there's crumb cake for the road.

slides.title: Florham Park Diner
slides.body: The sit-down stop. Pancakes, French toast, eggs Benedict and an omelette station that runs all day.

slides.title: AKB at Archer Hotel
slides.body: The slow stop. The hotel's bar and kitchen runs a breakfast buffet on weekend mornings and calls itself a spot for guests and locals.

slides.title: One Saturday in Florham Park
slides.tip: Tour on Saturday. Then drive your commute on a weekday morning before you offer.
